why: The slanting line moves one box clockwise each time: bottom-left, top-left, top-right, so next is bottom-right. The circle also moves one box clockwise: top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, so next is top-left. Option 1 has the line in the bottom-right box and the circle in the top-left box. Options 2, 3 and 4 just repeat earlier figures.
trick: Track each part (line and circle) separately and see which way it moves round the boxes.
